title: Geschäftsführender Partner (m/w/d) für Interim Manager und Berater: Mandate im Retainer statt Projekte im Tagessatz
company: thexton armstrong Nord und Ost Deutschland
description: Sie arbeiten als Interim Manager oder Berater und kennen die Grenzen des Projektgeschäfts: Jeder Auftrag beginnt mit einer unbezahlten Angebotsphase und endet mit dem Abschlussbericht. Wir bieten Ihnen ein Modell, in dem Mandate über monatliche Retainer laufen, in der Regel über zwölf Monate, mit fünf bis zehn Mandanten parallel, und in dem Sie mit Kollegen in fünf Ländern arbeiten statt allein. Unter der Marke thexton armstrong laden wir erfahrene Berater ein, als geschäftsführende Partner ihre eigene Beratungsgesellschaft in Nord- oder Ostdeutschland aufzubauen. Sie behalten Ihre Unabhängigkeit und gewinnen ein Angebot, das Inhaber sofort verstehen, ein Verfahren für den Einstieg beim Mandanten und eine Marke mit messbaren Ergebnissen. Ein Punkt vorweg: Sie arbeiten mit der Methodik von thexton armstrong, nicht mit Ihrer eigenen. Wer das als Gewinn sieht, passt zu uns. Über thexton armstrong Die Beratungsgesellschaft thexton armstrong ist ein internationales Netzwerk selbständiger Partner, spezialisiert auf die Begleitung von Geschäftsinhabern im Mittelstand und auf Wachstumsberatung. Seit 2012 haben unsere Partner mehreren tausend Geschäftsinhabern geholfen, Ertragskraft, Widerstandsfähigkeit und den langfristigen Wert ihrer Unternehmen zu steigern. Grundlage ist eine strukturierte Methodik, die praktische Führungserfahrung mit messbaren Ergebnissen verbindet. Wir sind selbst Unternehmer. Jeder Partner führt seine eigene Gesellschaft in einem exklusiven Gebiet und greift zugleich auf die Methodik, die Werkzeuge und das Wissen des gesamten Netzwerks zu. Wir sind in den Niederlanden, Belgien, Süddeutschland, der Schweiz und Großbritannien tätig und bauen jetzt Nord- und Ostdeutschland auf. Aufgaben Ihre Perspektive Regionales Wachstum verantworten: Sie gründen und führen Ihre Beratungsgesellschaft unter der Marke thexton armstrong mit exklusiven Rechte für ein Gebiet in Nord- oder Ostdeutschland. Unternehmen im Mittelstand voranbringen: Sie helfen Unternehmern versickerte Gewinne zu lokalisieren und in ins Unternehmen zurückzuführen. Mithilfe der proprietären thexton armstrong Programme befähigen Sie Unternehmer und Ihre Teams dauerhaft Wachstum, Ergebnis und Unternehmenswert zu steigern und Strukturen zu verbessern. Vom Projektgeschäft zum Mandantenstamm: Ihre Mandanten arbeiten mit Ihnen über monatliche Retainer statt Tagessätze, in der Regel über zwölf Monate und oft über Jahre. Mit fünf bis zehn Mandanten parallel entsteht eine Auslastung, die nicht mit jedem Projektende neu beginnt. Strukturiert akquirieren: Sie gewinnen Mandanten weiterhin selbst, aber mit einem erprobten Einstieg über Discovery-Gespräch und Test zur Gewinnversickerung statt offener Angebotspräsentationen. Dazu bauen Sie ein Empfehlungsnetzwerk aus Steuerberatern, Banken und anderen Partnern auf. Das Gesicht der Marke in Ihrer Region sein: Sie vertreten thexton armstrong gegenüber Unternehmern, Verbänden und Multiplikatoren und gestalten Marketing und Veranstaltungen gemeinsam mit der Regionalorganisation. International zusammenarbeiten: Sie tauschen sich mit Partnern in fünf Ländern über Mandate, Methoden und Erfahrungen aus. Qualifikation Ihr Hintergrund Sie sind seit mehreren Jahren als Interim Manager, Unternehmensberater oder Beirat für mittelständische Unternehmen tätig und haben davor selbst Führungs- und Ergebnisverantwortung getragen. Sie haben mit Inhabern und ihren Führungsteams gearbeitet, nicht nur mit Fachabteilungen in Konzernen. Sie akquirieren selbst und wollen das mit einem strukturierten Verfahren weiter tun. Sie sind bereit, sich auf gemeinsame Standards, eine gemeinsame Marke und ein gemeinsames Reporting einzulassen. Ihre Kompetenzen und Ihre Haltung strategisches und kaufmännisches Urteilsvermögen unternehmerischer Anspruch mit langfristiger Perspektive die Fähigkeit, mit Geschäftsführern und Inhabern Beziehungen aufzubauen und Vertrauen zu gewinnen unabhängig, belastbar, an Ergebnissen orientiert, pragmatisch und authentisch Deutsch fließend in Wort und Schrift auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (Pflicht), gutes Englisch und Wohnsitz in Nord- oder Ostdeutschland finanziell in der Lage, eine Anlaufphase zu überbrücken und den Ausbau des eigenen Geschäfts zu tragen Benefits Warum mit thexton armstrong? Erprobtes System: mehr als ein Jahrzehnt Erfahrung mit messbaren Ergebnissen für Mandanten und Partner. Der Erfolg jedes Mandats wird am realisierten Betrag gegenüber dem im Test festgestellten Betrag gemessen. Schlüsselfertiges Geschäftsmodell: Einarbeitung in zehn Workshoptagen über zwei Monate, Methodik, Online-Werkzeuge, Vorlagen und ein Startprogramm für die Mandantengewinnung. Sie entwickeln Ihr Angebot nicht mehr allein weiter. Unterstützung bei der Lead-Generierung: In der Startphase unterstützen wir Sie bei der Gewinnung von Erstkontakten zu Geschäftsinhabern, damit Sie schneller zu ersten Gesprächen kommen und Ihr Mandantenstamm zügiger wächst. Geringe Fixkosten, hohe Autonomie: Sie arbeiten vom Homeoffice oder einem Regionalbüro aus, ohne Personal zu Beginn, und entscheiden selbst über Tempo und Umfang des Ausbaus. Begleitung und Kollegenkreis: laufende Begleitung durch die Regionalverantwortlichen und ein internationales Netzwerk von Partnern mit vergleichbarem Hintergrund. Exklusives Gebiet: Ihr Gebiet ist Ihnen exklusiv zugeordnet; Sie bauen darin Ihren eigenen Mandantenstamm und Ihr eigenes Netzwerk auf. Aktiv akquirieren Sie in Ihrem Gebiet; Mandanten von außerhalb, die von sich aus auf Sie zukommen, dürfen Sie ebenfalls betreuen. Arbeit mit Wirkung: Sie sorgen dafür, dass Geschäftsinhaber ihre Unternehmen ertragsstärker und widerstandsfähiger führen und dabei selbst mehr Freiheit gewinnen. Rahmenbedingungen Sie arbeiten als Unternehmer. Es handelt sich nicht um eine sozialversicherungspflichtige Anstellung. Der Aufbau des Mandantenstamms ist Ihre Aufgabe. Im ersten Jahr steht die Gewinnung von Mandanten im Vordergrund; dafür erhalten Sie ein erprobtes Verfahren, laufende Begleitung und Unterstützung bei der Lead-Generierung. Die Einnahmen bauen sich in dieser Phase auf. Wie bestehende Mandate in der Übergangszeit behandelt werden, besprechen wir im Erstgespräch. Die wirtschaftlichen Rahmenbedingungen der Partnerschaft legen wir Ihnen im Erstgespräch vollständig offen. Zusagen zu Einkommen geben wir nicht. Gestalten Sie die Zukunft des Mittelstands in Nord- und Ostdeutschland mit. Dies ist mehr als eine Position: Es ist eine unternehmerische Führungsaufgabe mit Wachstumsperspektive für Berater, die ihre Erfahrung mit einem System und einem Kollegenkreis verbinden und im Mittelstand ihrer Region etwas bewegen wollen. Auswahl und Kontakt Der Weg zu einer Entscheidung führt über ein vertrauliches Erstgespräch (online, 30 bis 45 Minuten), eine Informationsveranstaltung, Gespräche mit bestehenden Partnern und eine Bedenkzeit vor der Unterschrift.Bewerben Sie sich mit Lebenslauf und einem kurzen Motivationsschreiben bei Christian von Volkmann, Managing Partner thexton armstrong Nord- und Ostdeutschland. Unsere Marken MIAMIO, Calmado und Tortillada werden in über 80 Ländern vertrieben — über unseren eigenen Onlineshop, sowie Amazon, Otto und weitere Marktplätze. Wir vereinen die komplette vertikale Wertschöpfungskette vom Design, der Entwicklung, der Produktion, sowie dem Vertrieb und Kundenservice von Produkten im Bereich Küche, Haushalt und Spielzeug. Als gestalterische Handschrift unserer Marken verantwortest du unsere Produkte von der ersten Skizze bis zur Serienfreigabe — Form, Material, Farbe und Funktion. Weil wir selbst entwickeln und produzieren, landen deine Entwürfe nicht in der Schublade: Sie stehen wenige Monate später in Haushalten weltweit. Aufgaben Konzeption & Entwurf: Du entwickelst innovative Produktdesigns — schwerpunktmäßig für unsere Brand MIAMIO — und begleitest sie von der Konzeption, über die Detaillierung und Ausarbeitung in 3D, bis hin zur Freigabe des serienreifen Prototypen. 3D-Modeling & Visualisierung: Du gestaltest detaillierte 3D-Modelle in CAD (vorzugsweise Blender) und erstellst daraus fotorealistische Renderings. KI-Tools nutzt du dabei selbstverständlich als Teil deines Workflows — für erste Konzeptvarianten, Moodboards und realistische Visualisierungen. 2D-Design: Du bringst Ideen schnell von Hand aufs Papier und illustrierst Dekore und Patterns eigenständig, die du bis zur serienreifen Print Datei für den Hersteller ausarbeitest. Briefings & technische Spezifikationen: Du erstellst Briefingunterlagen und technische Spezifikationen inklusive technischer Zeichnungen. Zudem definierst du Dekore, Glasuren, Farbwelten und Oberflächen. Machbarkeit & Zielkosten: Du denkst Materialien, Fertigungsverfahren, Toleranzen und Zielkosten von Anfang an mit — inklusive Verpackungsmaß und Versandfähigkeit im Onlinehandel. Dabei bist du stets in enger Abstimmung mit deinen Teamkollegen aus dem Produktmanagement und dem Sourcing Team. Design- & Trendresearch: Du erstellst Vision-Moodboards, screenst laufend Trends, Materialinnovationen und Wettbewerber. Nice to have: Verpackungsdesign: Du gestaltest ansprechende 2D Packaging Designs auf Basis der Dielines unserer Produktionspartner — inklusive druckfertiger Daten. Branding & Grafikdesign: Du unterstützt in der Markenkommunikation und bist in der Lage, Aufgaben im Bereich Grafikdesign, Brand Strategie und Fotografie zu übernehmen. Qualifikation Abgeschlossenes Studium: Im Bereich Produktdesign, Produktgestaltung, Industriedesign oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang. Erste Berufserfahrung wünschenswert, vorzugsweise im Bereich Consumer Goods oder Interiordesign. 3D-Software: Sicherer Umgang mit CAD-Software, vorzugsweise in Blender, Rhino oder Cinema 4D, sowie die Erstellung von fotorealistischen Renderings oder AI generierten Images Adobe Cloud: Sicherer Umgang in Adobe Photoshop und Adobe Illustrator. Design & Trends: Ein hohes Maß an Kreativität, ein sehr gutes Auge für Ästhetik und ein Gespür für Trends (primär im Home/Living/Interior Bereich), die unsere Zielgruppe begeistern. Material- & Fertigungsverständnis: Ein gutes Verständnis für Materialien wie Keramik, Porzellan, Glas, Metall oder Holz und deren Fertigungsverfahren — oder die Neugier, sich schnell einzuarbeiten. Eigenverantwortung: Strukturiertes, selbstständiges Arbeiten, hohe Eigenmotivation und Hands-on-Mentalität. Deutsch & Englisch: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Benefits Agiles Arbeitsumfeld: Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege — überzeugende Ideen werden schnell umgesetzt. Home Office Möglichkeit: 2 Tage Remote pro Woche möglich Ausstattung: leistungsstarke Workstation, Adobe- und Blender-Setup, 3D-Drucker vor Ort. Faire und wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung: Ein Gehalt, das deiner Expertise und Verantwortung entspricht. Weiterbildung & Events: Teilnahme an Branchenveranstaltungen sowie Raum für fachliche Weiterentwicklung. Zentrale Lage: Zentral gelegenes Büro in Stuttgart- Mitte.   • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, especially Kubernetes

  • Skilled in building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines

title: Geschäftsführender Partner (m/w/d) Unternehmerberatung im Mittelstand, Nord- und Ostdeutschland
company: thexton armstrong Nord und Ost Deutschland
description: Sie haben als Führungskraft, Unternehmer oder Berater über viele Jahre Verantwortung für Ergebnisse getragen und wollen diese Erfahrung in etwas Eigenes überführen: eine Beratungsgesellschaft in Ihrer Region, mit exklusivem Gebiet, einem erprobten System und Kollegen, die dasselbe tun. Unter der Marke thexton armstrong laden wir erfahrene Führungskräfte, Unternehmer und Berater ein, als geschäftsführende Partner ihre eigene Beratungsgesellschaft in Nord- oder Ostdeutschland aufzubauen. Sie beraten und begleiten Geschäftsinhaber im Mittelstand, Unternehmen mit 5 bis 250 Mitarbeitern, dabei, ihre Unternehmen ertragsstärker, widerstandsfähiger und wertvoller zu machen. Methodik, Werkzeuge, Marke und Einarbeitung sind vorhanden; Ihre Erfahrung, Ihr Netzwerk und Ihr unternehmerischer Anspruch sind der Teil, den Sie mitbringen. Über thexton armstrong Die Beratungsgesellschaft thexton armstrong ist ein internationales Netzwerk selbständiger Partner, spezialisiert auf die Begleitung von Geschäftsinhabern im Mittelstand und auf Wachstumsberatung. Seit 2012 haben unsere Partner mehreren tausend Geschäftsinhabern geholfen, Ertragskraft, Widerstandsfähigkeit und den langfristigen Wert ihrer Unternehmen zu steigern. Grundlage ist eine strukturierte Methodik, die praktische Führungserfahrung mit messbaren Ergebnissen verbindet. Wir sind selbst Unternehmer. Jeder Partner führt seine Gesellschaft in einem exklusiven Gebiet und greift zugleich auf die Methodik, die Werkzeuge und das Wissen des gesamten Netzwerks zu. Wir sind in den Niederlanden, Belgien, Süddeutschland, der Schweiz und Großbritannien tätig und bauen jetzt Nord- und Ostdeutschland auf. Aufgaben Ihre Perspektive Regionales Wachstum verantworten: Sie gründen und führen Ihre Beratungsgesellschaft unter der Marke thexton armstrong mit exklusiven Rechte für ein Gebiet in Nord- oder Ostdeutschland. Unternehmen im Mittelstand voranbringen: Sie helfen Unternehmern versickerte Gewinne zu lokalisieren und in ins Unternehmen zurückzuführen. Mithilfe der proprietären thexton armstrong Programme befähigen Sie Unternehmer und Ihre Teams dauerhaft Wachstum, Ergebnis und Unternehmenswert zu steigern und Strukturen zu verbessern. Langfristige Mandate aufbauen: Ihre Mandanten arbeiten mit Ihnen über monatliche Retainer, in der Regel über zwölf Monate und oft über Jahre. Mit fünf bis zehn Mandanten parallel entsteht ein Geschäft mit planbarem Rhythmus. Dazu bauen Sie ein Empfehlungsnetzwerk aus Steuerberatern, Banken und anderen Partnern auf. Das Gesicht der Marke in Ihrer Region sein: Sie vertreten thexton armstrong gegenüber Unternehmern, Verbänden und Multiplikatoren und gestalten Marketing und Veranstaltungen gemeinsam mit der Regionalorganisation. International zusammenarbeiten: Sie tauschen sich mit Partnern in fünf Ländern über Mandate, Methoden und Erfahrungen aus. Erprobtes System: mehr als ein Jahrzehnt Erfahrung mit messbaren Ergebnissen für Mandanten und Partner. Der Erfolg unserer Mandate ist durch die Langen Laufzeiten der Mandate dokumentiert auf eine intensive erste Phase von 12 – 18 Monaten folgt eine weniger aktive Phase, die oftmals über Jahre läuft. Schlüsselfertiges Geschäftsmodell: Live und online Onboarding workshops verteilt auf zwei Monate, Methodik, Online-Werkzeuge, Vorlagen und ein Startprogramm für die Mandantengewinnung. Unterstützung bei der Lead-Generierung: In der Startphase unterstützen wir Sie bei der Gewinnung von Erstkontakten zu Geschäftsinhabern, damit Sie schneller zu ersten Gesprächen kommen und Ihr Mandantenstamm zügiger wächst. Geringe Fixkosten, hohe Autonomie: Sie arbeiten vom Homeoffice oder einem Regionalbüro aus, ohne zusätzliche Personalkosten, und entscheiden selbst über Tempo und Umfang des Ausbaus. Begleitung und Kollegenkreis: laufende Begleitung durch die Regionalverantwortlichen und ein internationales Netzwerk von Partnern mit vergleichbarem Hintergrund. Exklusives Gebiet: Ihr Gebiet ist Ihnen exklusiv zugeordnet; Sie bauen darin Ihren eigenen Mandantenstamm und Ihr eigenes Netzwerk auf. Aktiv akquirieren Sie in Ihrem Gebiet; Mandanten von außerhalb, die von sich aus auf Sie zukommen, dürfen Sie ebenfalls betreuen. Arbeit mit Wirkung: Sie sorgen dafür, dass Geschäftsinhaber ihre Unternehmen ertragsstärker und widerstandsfähiger führen und dabei selbst mehr Freiheit gewinnen. Rahmenbedingungen Es handelt sich nicht um eine sozialversicherungspflichtige Anstellung. Der Aufbau des Mandantenstamms ist Ihre Aufgabe. Im ersten Jahr steht die Gewinnung von Mandanten im Vordergrund; dafür erhalten Sie von uns ein erprobtes Verfahren, laufende Begleitung und Unterstützung bei der Lead-Generierung. Die Einnahmen bauen sich in dieser Phase auf. Die wirtschaftlichen Rahmenbedingungen der Partnerschaft legen wir Ihnen im Erstgespräch vollständig offen. Gestalten Sie die Zukunft des Mittelstands in Nord- und Ostdeutschland mit. Dies ist mehr als eine Position: Es ist eine unternehmerische Führungsaufgabe mit Wachstumsperspektive für Menschen, die strategische Erfahrung mit unternehmerischer Freiheit verbinden und im Mittelstand ihrer Region etwas bewegen wollen. Auswahl und Kontakt Der Weg zu einer Entscheidung führt über ein vertrauliches Erstgespräch (online, 30 bis 45 Minuten), eine Informationsveranstaltung, Gespräche mit bestehenden Partnern und ausreichend Bedenkzeit. Wenn Sie noch angestellt sind: Wir behandeln Ihre Kontaktaufnahme vertraulich und legen Gespräche außerhalb Ihrer Arbeitszeit.Bewerben Sie sich mit Lebenslauf und einem kurzen Motivationsschreiben bei Christian von Volkmann, Geschäftsführer der VOVOI GmbH, verantwortlich für thexton armstrong in Nord- und Ostdeutschland.   • Contributing to the initial (and evolving) service portfolio of the AI Factory within a friendly and open work environment in a highly motivated, international team with opportunities to contribute with your own ideas

Required/Minimum Qualifications

 

  • PhD or Master’s degree in computer or data science, or other areas of scientific computing, or a Bachelor’s degree with multiple years (>3) of applied data platform development / engineering / deployment experience and/or working with AI data management workflows ideally as senior engineer in research or enterprise environments

  • Excellent English and preferably German presentation and writing skills
 

Additional and Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge and experience with dataspaces, ideally within the Common European Data Space initiative

title: Director, GTM & Revenue Operations
description: THE CARWOW GROUP Carwow Group is driven by a passion for getting people into cars. But not just any car, the right car. That’s why we are building the go-to destination for car-changing, whether you are looking to buy, sell or lease. Designed to reach drivers everywhere with our trail-blazing portfolio of personality rich automotive brands; Carwow, Auto Express, evo, Driving Electric and Car Buyer. What started as a simple reviews site, is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. Over 10m customers have used Carwow to help them buy and sell cars since its inception. In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia, doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with over 1.1 billion annual views, sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million. WHY JOIN US? We are winners of the prestigious Culture 100 award that recognises the most loved and happiest tech companies to work for! We have just raised $52m in funding led by global venture capital firm Bessemer Venture Partners (an early backer of LinkedIn and Shopify) to accelerate our growth plans! As pioneers, we’re always driving for new territory and positive change, so our work as a group is never done. Where others see difficulty, it’s our responsibility to see possibility – building new experiences, launching new titles and listening to drivers. Being a part of Carwow Group means championing drivers and the automotive industry, acting as a disrupter and never being afraid to fail (but learning fast when we do!). Our team of 600 employees across the UK, Germany, Spain and Portugal are revolutionising car-changing and we are fast expanding our mission across every single brand and country we operate in, so jump in! THE ROLE This is a director role running the operating engine behind our commercial teams. Carwow sells cars in two ways: Sell My Car, where drivers sell their car to dealers, and Get Your Car, where they buy or lease their next one. As Director, GTM & Revenue Operations you own the operating model those commercial teams run on: the go-to-market process, the enablement and quality that get people productive, the systems they work in (Salesforce and the wider commercial tech stack), the analytics that forecast the commercial number, and the programme management that lands cross-functional change. The function covers five areas: GTM Operations, Sales Enablement, Tooling & Platform, Rev-Ops Analytics and Program Management. You report to the VP, Marketplace Operations and sit close to both the numbers and the commercial teams you serve. You make the commercial motion work; the commercial teams own the selling and the relationships. This is a builder's role as much as a running one. You inherit a team of three (programme management, sales enablement and platform) and a clear mandate to grow the function to what the business needs. Shaping and hiring that team, and making the case for it, is central to the job. The commercial org has recently brought its Sell My Car and Get Your Car teams into a single account-management function serving one dealer network, so you'll run one operating model across both products (a unified Salesforce, aligned targets and comp, consistent enablement and quality) and get the last of that integration to steady state. The function has already moved real numbers here, reworking the sales process, standing up sales-engagement tooling and sharpening enablement, and your job is to take that further. You own the operating model, process, enablement, the systems requirement and the forecast. The commercial organisation owns the relationships, the selling and delivery against the number. You design the targets, compensation and territory structures with commercial leadership and you shape decisions through the strength of the operating case. In your first year, success looks like a forecast that's trusted and accurate, new hires productive faster, a consistent quality bar across the combined team, and the platform and process the org runs on every day. WHAT YOU’LL DO You will own the commercial operating model and the team that runs it, working hand in glove with the commercial organisation, Workforce Management, the trading leads, and the analytics and data teams that support the whole function. Own GTM operations: define the go-to-market playbook, pipeline and commercial process across both marketplaces, and, with commercial leadership, design the targets, compensation and territory / account structures that tie individual attainment to the business outcome. Own capacity and headcount planning with Workforce Management. Own sales enablement and quality: build the onboarding and ramp-to-productivity structures, a standard readiness sign-off, org-wide QA and calibration, and ongoing L&D for both individual contributors and leaders, so new hires get productive faster and quality holds across the organisation. Own the requirements for the commercial systems and tooling: direct Salesforce as the commercial system of record, owning the process and workflow design, prioritisation and the roadmap to bring the whole commercial org onto one platform, plus the sales-engagement and automation tooling (e.g. Groove), AI-assisted workflows and the performance dashboards the teams run on. You own the requirement and how the commercial org runs on the platform; the platform itself, its build and administration, sits with the tech org, who you partner with and direct. Own revenue-operations analytics and forecasting: produce a forward-looking commercial forecast that feeds trading and reconciles to Finance's P&L view, own the operational reporting that diagnoses what the volume and operational teams are driving into the number, and provide the evidence base behind comp and performance decisions. You own the operational read and set the requirement; you partner with Finance and the central analytics and data teams, who own the build. Own program management: run the commercial PMO, from end-to-end discovery and sizing of new initiatives through governance (charters, RACI, risk and impact), so cross-functional commercial programmes land on time with clear ownership. Build the function: shape and hire the team the function needs across the five areas, from a starting base of three, and make the case for the investment. Run the combined Sell My Car and Get Your Car commercial operation as one, a single dealer view, one operating model, and consistent process across both products. Get more out of the team with AI and automation: mature how the commercial org operates with AI-first tooling and automation, so manual workflows disappear and the org gets the answer without a person in the loop. Feed the operating rhythm: own the commercial-motion input into the weekly operating cadence and the read up to Finance, trading and the CEO, with a clean, leadership-ready view of where the pipeline sits and where it is heading. WHAT YOU’LL NEED Please note: We know that no candidate will be a perfect match for everything here, so please apply if you're close to the brief. If you meet most of the essentials, we'd like to hear from you. The essentials: A track record of leading a revenue-operations, commercial-operations or GTM-operations function at scale, in a marketplace, growth or B2B sales context Breadth across the operating model: you've owned, or closely partnered on, most of GTM process, enablement, commercial systems and analytics, and you understand how they fit together Strong CRM fluency with Salesforce as a system of record: you can set the requirements, shape the data model and process, and direct a platform team, not just keep it clean Commercial process and incentive design: targets, compensation, territory and capacity planning tied to business outcomes A people leader and builder: you've grown a multi-disciplinary team from a small base, hired well, and set a clear bar Analytical and data-fluent: comfortable in a forecast and a pipeline model, and drawing honest conclusions from the numbers How you'll work (we'll explore these in interview): Fluent and curious with AI: you use it to work faster and help a team adopt it Comfortable running a cross-functional PMO, with charters, RACI and clear risk management Credible with senior stakeholders: you make a well-evidenced case and hold it under challenge, and you influence across teams you don't own Self-directed: you turn an ambiguous problem into a plan, with a bias for action Intellectually honest: you surface the hard truth early rather than the comfortable answer late Nice to have: Hands-on Salesforce administration or architecture (certification a plus), CPQ, and sales-engagement / revenue-intelligence tooling (e.g. Groove, Outreach) SQL / data warehouse fluency Marketplace, two-sided platform or automotive experience Process-improvement or operational-excellence training (e.g. Lean Six Sigma), especially paired with a commercial background INTERVIEW PROCESS Phone screen with a member of the Talent Team First round interview with the hiring manager focussed on prior experience Second round made up of a case study presentation on a revenue-operations problem (we'll send the brief in advance and give you time to prepare) Situational/company values interview with senior members of the leadership team Final round interview with a member of the Exec team We want everyone to do their best thinking, so if you'd like any adjustments to the process, just let us know. WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU Hybrid working: 3 days a week in the office, 2 remote Competitive salary Matched pension contributions Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement Share options - when we thrive, so do you! Vitality Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers Life Assurance for (even more) peace of mind Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner 28 days annual leave plus bank holidays, rising to 30 days after 3 years and 35 after 10 years, with the option to buy 3 additional days 1 day of leave for your wedding, and 1 day when you move house Work from abroad for a month Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, plus fertility treatment and pregnancy loss support Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees Up to £500/€550 home office allowance Learning and development budget Regular team and company social events Refer-a-friend bonus scheme Diversity and inclusion is an integral part of our culture. We know that diverse teams are strong teams, so we welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply for this position. We make recruiting decisions based on experience, skills and potential, so all our applicants are treated fairly and equally. #LI-RV1 Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Own capacity and headcount planning with Workforce Management.

  • Own sales enablement and quality: build the onboarding and ramp-to-productivity structures, a standard readiness sign-off, org-wide QA and calibration, and ongoing L&D for both individual contributors and leaders, so new hires get productive faster and quality holds across the organisation.

  • Own the requirements for the commercial systems and tooling: direct Salesforce as the commercial system of record, owning the process and workflow design, prioritisation and the roadmap to bring the whole commercial org onto one platform, plus the sales-engagement and automation tooling (e.g. Groove), AI-assisted workflows and the performance dashboards the teams run on. You own the requirement and how the commercial org runs on the platform; the platform itself, its build and administration, sits with the tech org, who you partner with and direct.

  • Own revenue-operations analytics and forecasting: produce a forward-looking commercial forecast that feeds trading and reconciles to Finance's P&L view, own the operational reporting that diagnoses what the volume and operational teams are driving into the number, and provide the evidence base behind comp and performance decisions. You own the operational read and set the requirement; you partner with Finance and the central analytics and data teams, who own the build.

  • Own program management: run the commercial PMO, from end-to-end discovery and sizing of new initiatives through governance (charters, RACI, risk and impact), so cross-functional commercial programmes land on time with clear ownership.

  • Build the function: shape and hire the team the function needs across the five areas, from a starting base of three, and make the case for the investment. Run the combined Sell My Car and Get Your Car commercial operation as one, a single dealer view, one operating model, and consistent process across both products.

  • Get more out of the team with AI and automation: mature how the commercial org operates with AI-first tooling and automation, so manual workflows disappear and the org gets the answer without a person in the loop.

  • Feed the operating rhythm: own the commercial-motion input into the weekly operating cadence and the read up to Finance, trading and the CEO, with a clean, leadership-ready view of where the pipeline sits and where it is heading.


WHAT YOU’LL NEED

Please note: We know that no candidate will be a perfect match for everything here, so please apply if you're close to the brief. If you meet most of the essentials, we'd like to hear from you.

The essentials:

  • A track record of leading a revenue-operations, commercial-operations or GTM-operations function at scale, in a marketplace, growth or B2B sales context

  • Breadth across the operating model: you've owned, or closely partnered on, most of GTM process, enablement, commercial systems and analytics, and you understand how they fit together

  • Strong CRM fluency with Salesforce as a system of record: you can set the requirements, shape the data model and process, and direct a platform team, not just keep it clean

  • Commercial process and incentive design: targets, compensation, territory and capacity planning tied to business outcomes

  • A people leader and builder: you've grown a multi-disciplinary team from a small base, hired well, and set a clear bar

  • Analytical and data-fluent: comfortable in a forecast and a pipeline model, and drawing honest conclusions from the numbers

How you'll work (we'll explore these in interview):

  • Fluent and curious with AI: you use it to work faster and help a team adopt it

  • Comfortable running a cross-functional PMO, with charters, RACI and clear risk management

  • Credible with senior stakeholders: you make a well-evidenced case and hold it under challenge, and you influence across teams you don't own

  • Self-directed: you turn an ambiguous problem into a plan, with a bias for action

  • Intellectually honest: you surface the hard truth early rather than the comfortable answer late

Nice to have:

title: Payroll Implementation Manager
description: Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them. Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past. We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth.

That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it.

We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three.

But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.

Does this sound like you?

You're a senior data leader who has taken a data function through genuine transformation, and who is as comfortable presenting to a CEO as you are defending a methodology to a peer. You understand what a high performing function looks like, you know how to build toward it, and you have the credibility and composure to hold your ground when the data tells a story that senior stakeholders don't want to hear.

What you'll do

You'll play a key role in shifting the function from a service that reports what has happened to one that drives decisions about what should happen next. You'll work closely with the Head of Data to lay the foundations for a more strategic, consultative model, building the team, the tools, and the ways of working that will continue to move Flagstone from reactive reporting to predictive, commercially driven insights.

This will include:

  • Setting the analytics roadmap, prioritising and sequencing delivery so the function is focused on the work that will have the greatest commercial impact

  • Setting a clear direction for establishing and growing data science capability within the function, systematically reducing low value activity to create the capacity to get there

  • Driving measurable adoption of self serve analytics across Growth, Engagement, Partnerships and beyond. This isn't about publishing dashboards, it's about training, supporting, and tracking uptake so ad hoc request volume falls and teams own their own insights.

  • Rebalancing delivery accountability that currently sits too heavily with analytics, working with tribe leads through sustained and active escalation to shift ownership back to them

  • Leading and line managing Data Analysts and Senior Data Analysts, setting clear expectations for quality, delivery, and behaviour, and acting as the escalation point for analytical disputes, ambiguity, or risk

  • Leading from the front on modern tooling and applied data science methods, and building the team's capability through coaching, pairing, and structured development.

  • Helping analysts understand how their role is evolving, encouraging the team to move from responding to requests to proactively identifying opportunities and influencing decisions.

  • Operating as a credible authority with C Suite level stakeholders, with the composure and evidence to challenge assumptions, and clearly articulate what the data does and does not support

  • Defending analytical methodology under scrutiny, clearly articulating why a model or approach was chosen over alternatives and what could undermine it

  • Exercising independent judgement on when an insight is significant enough to escalate and when it can wait, taking accountability for the downstream business impact of analytical outputs, not just their technical correctness

  • Owning the most complex and high impact analytical work, including methodology selection, assumptions, and interpretation.

  • Ensuring all outputs are trusted, contextualised, reproducible, and aligned with governance expectations before informing decisions.

What you'll bring

  • Significant experience in data analytics, including ownership of high stakes analysis and operation as a hybrid IC / manager.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage C Suite level stakeholders, with the gravitas and credibility to influence at the most senior levels and the confidence to challenge when the data demands it

  • Proven track record of landing self serve adoption where you've led a team through this shift before. You can point to measurable outcomes e.g. falling ad hoc volume, teams confidently self-serving, sustained change.

  • Experience rebalancing accountability in matrixed environments. You've worked in cross functional organisations where product/tribe leadership needed to own their data insights. You know how to escalate, how to hold boundaries, and how to make the shift stick.

  • Experience in building partnerships across functions, not just within your team or your immediate leadership chain, but with tribe leads, product managers, and operational teams. You've driven adoption of your team's work.

  • Strong hands on technical capability, including SQL, Power BI, and Python or similar. You build capability by doing, not just directing.

  • Communication and conviction, with the ability to operate credibly with senior stakeholders and hold the line on quality and ways of working when it matters.

How we reward you:

At Flagstone, the benefits extend beyond false gifts like “fruit and snacks”. Instead, we invest in your health, wealth, and professional development. Here’s a selection of our benefits:

  • Hybrid working - Spend at least 1 day a week with your team in our collaborative London office

  • Competitive bonus scheme - designed to reward and recognise high performance

  • Flexible benefits budget - a pot to fund meaningful benefits for you, whether it's hormone or fertility testing, cancer screening, neuro-diversity coaching or something that matters for you.

  • A range of salary sacrifice options to help you make tax efficient savings on electric cars, nursery schemes, home and tech goods.

  • Working Abroad - Flagstone employees can work remotely from an approved list of locations for up to 90 days a year

  • Mental wellbeing support – Access therapy and mental health sessions through Spill

  • Learning and development – £1,000 personal development budget to help you grow in your role.

  • Private health care - Enjoy all the benefits AXA has to offer, including reduced gym memberships and medical history disregarded

  • Medical cash plan - To help you with the costs of dental and optical expenses

  • Life insurance and Income Protection- four times your annual salary for peace of mind

  • Matched pension contributions up to 5%

  • 25 days holiday - plus bank holidays, well-being days and volunteering days

  • Enhanced Parental Leave – enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption pay.

All are welcome.

What is Flagstone?

Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business – where smart people do their best work.

Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It's our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage.

A feel for our culture

To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth.

That's why we're building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it.

We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three.

But enough about us. Let's talk about you.

The Role

Flagstone's relationship with one of the UK's largest national wealth networks is the largest and most strategically significant partnership in the business, it's a corporate agreement giving the network's Partners access to the Flagstone platform to refer their clients' cash. With over 5,000 Partners across four regions and significant untapped potential, the ARM role is central to how we grow.

The ARM – Strategic Network Partnership role is both a sales and a relationship role. You will be proactively visiting Partners across London and the Home Counties, educating them on the Flagstone proposition, encouraging and enabling them to refer their clients, and ensuring that any barriers to referral are identified and removed. At the same time, you will be the first point of contact when Partners have queries or need support.

What You'll Be Doing

Proactive Partner Engagement

Own a defined regional portfolio of Partners, taking personal responsibility for the depth of engagement and the volume and quality of referrals generated

Spend the substantial majority of your time in the field visiting Partners in their offices and practices, attending regional network events, and building face-to-face relationships that drive consistent referral behaviour

Proactively reach out to Partners who are registered but not yet actively referring, understanding what is holding them back and working to unlock their activity

Work to deepen engagement with active Partners, helping them identify more of their clients who could benefit from the Flagstone platform

Proposition Training & Education

Deliver clear, confident, and compelling presentations of the Flagstone proposition to Partners, both individually and in group settings

Keep Partners up to date with product developments, platform enhancements, and any changes to how Flagstone works within the network framework

Develop a thorough understanding of the network's adviser framework, the restrictions Partners operate under as Appointed Representatives, and how Flagstone fits within the products they are permitted to recommend

Use insight from Partner conversations to feed back objections, platform friction points, or proposition gaps that are limiting referral activity

Reactive Support & Pipeline Management

Act as a knowledgeable and responsive point of contact for Partners when they have questions about Flagstone, the referral process, or platform features

Resolve queries with pace and accuracy, always closing the loop with the Partner

Support Partners through the onboarding of referred clients, ensuring any friction is addressed quickly

Maintain a clear and current picture of your regional pipeline tracking Partner engagement levels, referral volumes, and conversion activity

Report regularly to the Relationships Team Lead on the health of your region: what is working, where the opportunities are, and where support is needed

What You'll Bring

Field Sales & Relationship Management

Experience in a field-based sales or relationship management role, with a proven track record of building trusted relationships face to face and converting engagement into commercial outcomes

Genuine comfort being out in the field every day - you need to be energised by travel, variety, and in-person interaction

The personal presence and communication skills to represent Flagstone confidently in front of financial advisers and wealth professionals, one-to-one or in a group setting

Financial Services Knowledge

An understanding of the financial advice market, the IFA and restricted adviser landscape, and how cash management fits within an adviser's client proposition

Familiarity with large national wealth network models is an advantage - how Partners operate, the restrictions they work under as Appointed Representatives, and the dynamics of a corporate distribution partnership

Sufficient financial literacy to have credible conversations about cash, interest rates, FSCS protection, and multi-bank diversification

Commercial Drive & Self-Direction

A commercially motivated self-starter who takes personal ownership of regional performance and does not wait to be told where to focus

Organised and disciplined in how you manage your territory: you plan your time, track your pipeline, and follow up consistently

Competitive bonus scheme - designed to reward and recognise high performance

Flexible benefits budget - a pot to fund meaningful benefits for you, whether it's hormone or fertility testing, cancer screening, neuro-diversity coaching or something that matters for you.

A range of salary sacrifice options to help you make tax efficient savings on electric cars, nursery schemes, home and tech goods.

Learning and development – £1,000 personal development budget to help you grow in your role.

25 days holiday - plus bank holidays, well-being days and volunteering days

Enhanced Parental Leave – enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption pay.

Craft that's respected, not traded off. Strict typing, layered testing, ADRs, observability — and AI-native ways of working as the baseline, not an experiment. Prescription & eligibility — build the product which helps learners and customers understand the best learning course for their skills and career development, that leverages a customer's levy funds. Much of this is load-bearing logic with a genuine financial and regulatory blast radius. Recommendation & onboarding — turning a diagnosis into the right prescribed path and getting learners into it, where those decisions become visible to customers and learners. The platform arc — continuing to carve D&P logic out of the shared legacy monolith into dedicated services, while backing the newer AI-native product from beta toward scale. Coach and build the team. Hire well, give every report a real growth plan, and move the team into a high-performing, AI-native operating rhythm — promotions and performance issues are never a surprise. Stay hands-on. raw.title: Senior Engineering Manager
raw.description:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.

Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

Why this role exists

Every foundation model lab is solving the same problem: build more capability. Almost nobody is solving the harder one — what happens when that capability meets a real organisation and real people who have to relearn how they work. That's the adoption layer, still wide open, and Multiverse sits in the unique position to solve this problem with ten years of proprietary learner and employer data driven from 1,500+ companies that no one else has.

Diagnose & Prescribe (D&P) is the engine room of that problem. It works out what a learner or employer actually needs, then decides what they get funded for and which apprenticeship or learning path they're pointed to next. D&P is how we assess a learner's or employer's skill gaps, decide what they need, and point them to the right apprenticeship or learning path — so the blast radius here is human and financial, not just a dashboard metric.

The line between leading this team and building the product has already blurred, which is why this role exists as it does. We need a leader who stays close enough to the work to have credible judgment in it, and who builds a high-trust team where diverse perspectives actually make the problem-solving better.

This is a broad, domain-coherent, event-driven and increasingly AI-native estate. The dominant challenge isn't deep algorithmic difficulty in any single repo — it's holding the whole D&P picture, sequencing work across varied services, and keeping load-bearing decisions safe as the system evolves underneath you.

What you're signing up for

  • A genuinely unsolved problem — the constraint here is people and adoption, not model capability.

  • High agency. We set outcomes, not playbooks. You and your team define how this evolves.

  • Real commercial breadth. This team sits at the intersection of Product, go-to-market, and eligibility — closer to the customer than most engineering roles.

  • Craft that's respected, not traded off. Strict typing, layered testing, ADRs, observability — and AI-native ways of working as the baseline, not an experiment.

  • A company mid-transformation, told straight. Multiverse is rebuilding itself into a product-powered, AI-native company in real time. You're not inheriting a finished system — you're one of the people defining it.

What you'll do

You will own delivery, technical direction, and team health in the D&P service estate — the full learner and customer journey from diagnosis through prescription to onboarding and growth tracking. Concretely, that means leading the team(s) across surfaces like:

  • Diagnosis & needs assessment — AI-heavy services (retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), LLM-scored assessment) that turn raw signal into a picture of where a learner or employer actually is.

  • Prescription & eligibility — build the product which helps learners and customers understand the best learning course for their skills and career development, that leverages a customer's levy funds. Much of this is load-bearing logic with a genuine financial and regulatory blast radius.

  • Recommendation & onboarding — turning a diagnosis into the right prescribed path and getting learners into it, where those decisions become visible to customers and learners.

  • The platform arc — continuing to carve D&P logic out of the shared legacy monolith into dedicated services, while backing the newer AI-native product from beta toward scale.

  • Coach and build the team. Hire well, give every report a real growth plan, and move the team into a high-performing, AI-native operating rhythm — promotions and performance issues are never a surprise.

  • Stay hands-on. Whiteboard distributed designs, review and negotiate the RabbitMQ event schemas and API contracts that ripple across services, and write production code yourself when it's the fastest way to de-risk or unblock.

  • Deliver predictably. Use cycle time, change failure rate, and MTTR to balance shipping speed, debt, and change-safety on logic with genuine financial and regulatory blast radius.

  • Raise the AI-native bar. Prove better discovery-to-build-to-review loops on your own team and share what works across engineering.

  • Partner on strategy. Work directly with Product and Design — and closely with go-to-market — to turn learner and customer behaviour into technical direction on the surfaces where eligibility and recommendation decisions become visible to real customers.

What we need

A few terms you'll see below: D&P (Diagnose & Prescribe, this team's name), BAM (our hiring framework — Behaviour, Achievement, Mastery), ADRs (architecture decision records), IfATE (the UK body governing apprenticeship standards).

  • Engineering management of full-stack teams shipping production software, with real technical depth to review architecture and challenge design.

  • A team you led has shipped AI features to real users and operated them — not a side experiment.

  • Strong Python/TypeScript (if you don’t have Typescript, you will need to learn): React/Next.js (App Router, RSC, server actions), tRPC/GraphQL, Node/Express.

  • PostgreSQL at scale via an ORM, with migration discipline on large, live schemas.

  • Event-driven systems on a message bus (we use RabbitMQ) — versioned events, idempotency, backward-compatible migration.

  • A high engineering maturity bar as second nature: typing, testing, feature flags, ADRs, CI/CD, observability.

  • AI-native delivery in practice — you build daily with Claude Code, Cursor, or the current best tool, and understand context management, model selection, tool design, and the token economics that separate a prototype from an affordable production system.

What sets you apart

  • GTM/acquisition-funnel experience — you've owned surfaces where onboarding and eligibility meet real customers.

  • Strangler-pattern pragmatism — legacy monolith and greenfield edge-native product, at the same time.

  • Accessibility and UX as defaults on learner-facing surfaces, not afterthoughts.

Not for you if

This role won't fit if you'd rather run ceremonies than stay in the system, the design, and the code yourself. It also won't fit if you see AI tooling as a productivity tweak rather than a step change in how a team works. And it needs someone who renegotiates the scope out loud when it's wrong, not someone who absorbs it and hopes it works out.

Stack & how we lead

TypeScript core (React/Next.js, Node) with PostgreSQL and RabbitMQ as the event backbone, plus Python and Elixir services — from RAG pipelines to a Claude-powered edge-native product. GitHub, CircleCI, Datadog. AI-assisted development is first-class, not bolted on.

You'll lead full-stack engineers (with Python/Elixir specialists), report to the Senior Director of Engineering for Diagnose & Prescribe, and calibrate regularly with a peer group of EMs — you're not doing this alone. We reject micro-management: we set the objective, you and your team own the how. Kindness, candour, and curiosity over hierarchy — bad news travels as fast as good.

Benefits

  • Time off - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company-wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year

  • Health & Wellness- private medical Insurance with Bupa, a medical cashback scheme, life insurance, gym membership & wellness resources through Wellhub and access to Spill - all in one mental health support

  • Hybrid work offering - for most roles we collaborate in the office three days per week with the exception of Coaches and Instructors who collaborate in the office once a month

  • Work-from-anywhere scheme - you'll have the opportunity to work from anywhere, up to 10 days per year

  • Space to connect: Beyond the desk, we make time for weekly catch-ups, seasonal celebrations, and have a kitchen that’s always stocked!


Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal opportunities employer. And proud of it. Every applicant and employee is afforded the same opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. This will never change. Read our Equality, Diversity & Inclusion policy here.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

Multiverse is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of our learners. We expect all employees to share this commitment and adhere to our Safeguarding Policy, our Prevent Policy and all other Multiverse company policies. Successful applicants will be required to undertake at least a Basic check via the Disclosure Barring Service (DBS).

For roles that will involve a Regulated Activity, successful applicants must also undergo an Enhanced DBS check, including a Children’s Barred List check and a Prohibition Order check. Roles involving Regulated Activity may interact with vulnerable groups, therefore are exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 meaning applicants are required to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, and final warnings.

Providing false information is an offence and could result in the application being rejected or summary dismissal if the applicant has been selected, and possible referral to the police and the DBS.

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

Zip is looking for a highly motivated, outgoing, and tech-savvy sales representative with strong business acumen to join our growing Business Development team. As a Business Development Representative, you will generate new business by prospecting outbound leads through cold outreach and work collaboratively across our sales organization to set high-value meetings. This is a highly strategic role that requires creativity, resilience, and the ability to partner effectively with an Account Executive to create new business opportunities. This is a fully in-office role supporting our EMEA team.

Joining the Business Development team is an opportunity to fast-track your career in sales. Applicants should have a growth mindset and be excited to work collaboratively across the Revenue organization. You will learn consultative selling and hone in on our best-in-class outbound motion to execute our sales strategy. High performers in the BDR role will open up new opportunities for career growth within our rapidly growing organization.

We’re looking for a customer-focused, highly motivated, and driven individual with a desire to grow and advance in a career in sales. If you have a proactive and customer-first mentality with the passion to demonstrate Zip’s commitment to our merchants, we’d love to talk to you!

You Will

  • Partner closely with our VP of Sales and Account Executives to identify and source meetings that lead to pipeline and closed revenue

  • Prospect across a high volume of accounts, with a keen eye on strategically prioritizing your time

  • Become a market expert – researching and understanding our target industries and personas, and what makes them tick

  • Build a point of view on how to help customers with their needs and the right qualifying questions to ask

  • Be adaptable and flexible – as part of an early-stage hyper growth company, we are rapidly growing out our process but we want to you to help shape our sales process

Qualifications

  • 6-12+ months or equivalent sales experience

  • A consistent track record of meeting and exceeding goals

  • Be a highly strategic thinker and problem solver with a solutions first and adaptable mindset

  • Ability to work from our office off of Kings Cross station, 5 days a week. Opportunity to move to a hybrid scheduled once hitting quota! 

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, ZoomInfo, ScratchPad, Gong, and/or SalesNavigator

  • Tech experience or proven success in a fast-paced environment

  • A strong passion for fintech is a plus

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a paramount focus on detail

  • An ability to celebrate change and embrace accountability

Within 2 weeks, you will...

  • Complete Zip’s new hire training & onboarding program alongside other new Zip team members

  • Gain a broader understanding of our products and how your role fits into the organization

  • Partner with the Director of Business Development on key success metrics for your role and how you will measure against them

  • Partner with the Director of Business Development to discuss your personal and professional goals

  • Begin developing familiarity with our business, platform, and applications, as well as our company’s key metrics

  • Acclimate yourself with the day-to-day responsibilities of Zip’s Business Development team by shadowing team members, listening to recorded customer calls, and working closely with our Account Executive team

Within 1 month, you will...

  • Identify and contact prospective clients to build a pipeline through a variety of methods including, but not limited to cold-calling, emailing, social media outreach, and mass email campaigns

  • Create a professional and engaging first impression with our prospects and customers

  • Create, maintain and update our database of prospects with complete information and emails

  • Thoroughly qualify all outbound opportunities and collaborate with Account Executives for a smooth and sophisticated customer experience

  • Generate net new business through outbound prospecting

  • Prioritize leads, research prospects and position relevant product features to solve business needs while strategically managing your time

  • Manage follow-up with calls-to-action to consistently build a sales pipeline

Within 2 months, you will...

Achieve department standards for activity that includes:

  • Making a minimum number of quality outbound calls per day

  • Scheduling a minimum number of new quality discovery calls per week

  • Become a market expert by researching and understanding our target industries and personas

  • Exceed activity and pipeline goals on a monthly basis

  • Consistently reflect on your own skill and development gaps along with the Director of Business Development to identify personal and professional goals

  • Become a mentor to new hires entering into the Business Development organization

  • Become a key stakeholder in Zip’s growth as we continue to scale our core business

Perks & Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

  • 📈 Start-up equity

  • 🦷 Health, vision & dental coverage

  • Commuter benefit

  • 🌴 Flexible PTO

  • 💻 Apple equipment plus home office stipend

  • 5% Employer Pension Contribution

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

raw.description:
Why loveholidays?

At loveholidays - we trailblaze together. We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers’ unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway. Our team is the driving force behind our role as our customers’ personal holiday expert - the smart way to get away.

Here, we're doing things differently to open the world to everyone, and our Customer Experience team is at the forefront of driving cutting-edge innovation. Join our fast-growing business where your ideas are heard and new thinking shapes how millions book their holidays.

You'll accelerate your growth in our fast-paced environment, tackling daily challenges and learning from inspiring leaders and teammates. Be empowered to create impact for our future by shaping the most-loved package holiday experience for millions. As we pursue ambitious plans to expand across Europe, you'll be part of a fun-loving international community achieving great things together.

About the team:

The On Holiday Support team helps customers resolve issues that arise while they are away. This can include transfer problems, accommodation concerns, supplier issues, flight disruption and other unexpected situations that may affect a customer’s holiday.

Customers may contact us when they are tired, worried, frustrated or unsure what to do next. Our role is to listen, understand what has happened and take ownership of finding the most appropriate resolution.

You will be part of the UK On Holiday Support team and report to an On Holiday Support Team Leader. You will also work closely with colleagues in our offshore partner team and with suppliers and internal departments across loveholidays..

Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. We welcome applications from candidates based in London and the surrounding areas. As this role requires some attendance at our London office, applications from candidates with a commute of more than 2 hours each way will not be considered.

The impact you’ll have:

You’ll support customers at moments when the service we provide can have a real impact on their holiday, taking ownership and responding with empathy, urgency and sound judgement.

This means investigating what’s happened, communicating clearly and working towards practical resolutions. Some cases will be straightforward, while others may require supplier contact, further investigation or escalation to specialist teams.

Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. A customer-first mindset and strong problem-solving skills are essential, particularly when handling more challenging cases and helping restore customers’ confidence in loveholidays. You’ll also support English-speaking customers across our international markets.

High performers may have opportunities to develop into specialist areas, including wellbeing and safeguarding.

Your day-to-day:

  • Support customers through telephone, chat and case-based contact while they are on holiday

  • Listen carefully, understand the customer’s circumstances and identify the most appropriate next steps

  • Take ownership of customer issues and work towards a resolution wherever possible

  • Use good judgement to balance customer needs, urgency, safety, policy and commercial considerations

  • Contact hotels, transfer providers, airlines and other suppliers to investigate issues and agree solutions

  • Make outbound calls when speaking directly with a customer or supplier is the quickest and most effective way to resolve an issue

  • Keep customers updated and set clear expectations throughout their case

  • Recognise risk and escalate safeguarding, wellbeing or major incident concerns through the correct process

  • Maintain clear, accurate and complete case notes

  • Work collaboratively with colleagues in the UK, our offshore partner and other loveholidays teams

  • Identify recurring customer or supplier issues and provide feedback so that the underlying cause can be addressed

  • Maintain an up-to-date understanding of relevant processes, policies, systems and travel-industry developments

Your skillset:

  • Strong and demonstrable customer-service skills

  • A calm, empathetic and professional communication style

  • Confidence speaking with customers who may be upset, frustrated or under pressure

  • Strong ownership and a willingness to see issues through to resolution

  • Sound judgement and the confidence to make decisions within agreed guidelines

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Strong problem-solving and investigative skills

  • Excellent organisation and attention to detail

  • Emotional resilience and the ability to work effectively with sensitive or challenging customer situations

  • A collaborative approach and confidence working with colleagues from different teams and cultures

The interview journey:

  1. Intro to a member of the Talent Acquisition team - 20 minutes

  2. Interview and assessment with the Hiring Manager and Team Leader – 60 minutes

Perks of joining us:

Other than an amazing environment for you to grow, have impact and show the world your incredible skills, we offer the following benefits:

  • Company pension contributions at 5%

  • Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up

  • Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends

  • 25 days of holidays per annum (plus 8 public holidays) increases by 1 day for every second year of service, up to a maximum 30 days per annum

  • Enhanced maternity/paternity leave

  • Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers

At loveholidays, we focus on developing an inclusive culture and environment that encourages personal growth and collective success. Each individual offers unique perspectives and ideas that increase the diversity and effectiveness of our teams. And we value the insight and potential you could bring on our continued journey.

description: Centreon cherche à renforcer l'équipe sécurité en intégrant un senior security engineer. Au cœur du produit Centreon, la team security a un impact fort. Elle joue un rôle central au sein de la R&D composée d’environ 50 tech. Elle collabore notamment étroitement avec les équipes  infra cloud et software engineers. Pluridisciplinaire, vous intégrez une équipe composée de 2 personnes au profils riches et variés. Vous êtes expert sur la partie Cloud et notamment AWS . Vous accompagnerez l’ensemble de la tech (dev, product, SRE) pour apporter les best practices, construire la plateforme, automatiser  les process, déployer des composants, opérer des solutions etc  Vos missions seront diverses et  toujours guidées par l’envie de partager les succès mais avec un ownership fort. Missions :  Intégrer les pratiques de sécurité dans le cycle complet de notre infrastructure et de notre plateforme cloud en interne ainsi que dans nos produits SaaS. Contribuer au développement d'une architecture de sécurité robuste qui s'aligne sur le modèle zéro trust. Renforcer la sécurité du cloud (AWS, on-prem), participer au hardening de l’infra, à la protection contre les menaces avancées et à la conception de SaaS sécurisés. Participer activement à une équipe d'ingénieurs diversifiée composée d'ingénieurs en sécurité, d'ingénieurs logiciels, de devops et de SRE. Construire et opérer la stratégie de sécurisation des usages et technologies d'IA au sein de l'entreprise; Garantir la maintenabilité et l'évolutivité des différents composants, en diffusant les best practices de sécurité à l'état de l'art ; Collaborer avec les software engineers, l'équipe infra et le produit pour construire des produits et des services secure by design ; Construire une stratégie de réponse aux incidents efficace et solide à l’aide de systèmes d'alerting  et de détection modernes ; corriger et mitiger les problèmes de sécurité en collaboration avec l'équipe Infra.. Faire évoluer les capacités de l'équipe sécurité en s'appuyant sur l'IA agentique pour automatiser le traitement des tâches répétitives (alertes, triage, reporting) Être un membre actif de la guilde de sécurité Bug Bounty management Stack technique : AWS – Terraform – Zero trust : Okta, Teleport  - SSLDC - SIEM  Profil et compétences  Vous êtes autonome et faites preuve d’ownership, êtes capable de leader des projet transverses Vous avez une expérience significative en sécurité des infra cloud : système, réseau et notamment AWS. Vous avez une bonne compréhension de la sécurité dans les systèmes distribués à l'échelle.. Vous avez une bonne connaissance de la gestion de l'IAM sur les fournisseurs de cloud (AWS, Auth0). Vous maîtrisez un ou plusieurs langages de notre stack tech. Vous avez un intérêt pour l'écosystème OpenSource et pour le monitoring. Vous aimez innover et faire évoluer les architectures des plateformes vers une plus grande scalabilité. Vous voulez être un membre actif d'une équipe d'ingénieurs diversifiée composée d'ingénieurs en sécurité, d'ingénieurs logiciels, de devops et de SRE. Les plus qui feront la différence  : Vous avez des compétences ou expériences et intérêt pour la sécurité corporate IT  (SSO/IAM, EDR, MDM...) Vous êtes sensible à la culture de l’open-source  Vous êtes sensible à l’expérience utilisateur (performance, ergonomie, utilisabilité, etc.)  Vous aimez défier vos collègues au babyfoot !  Ce que nous offrons Société en forte croissance (+20%  en 2025) dans un environnement international Venez apprécier nos locaux à Paris avec terrasse à Olympiade - Métro ligne 14 ou à Toulouse quartier Compans Caffarelli (immeubles accessibles PMR) RTT et Carte Tickets restaurant Events mensuels et semestriels Petits dej mensuels Un programme d'Onboarding Pleins d'autres avantages -->  https://centreon.recruitee.com/qui-sommes-nous Nous avons à cœur de mettre en avant la diversité au sein de notre entreprise. Managed-services engagements, where you act as the delivery owner and project manager for an ongoing customer relationship. Proactively identify risks such as declining adoption, missed milestones, unclear ownership, or limited use of the platform. Surface relevant expansion or cross-sell opportunities to the Customer Success and Sales teams. This is not a quota-carrying sales role, but you are expected to recognize when additional Contentsquare capabilities or services could address a customer need. Identify opportunities to improve customer processes, measurement practices, data flows, or use of digital analytics. Improve how we work Contribute to reusable consulting methods, frameworks, templates, and points of view. Use artificial intelligence responsibly to improve preparation, analysis, delivery quality, and internal processes. Stay current with developments in digital analytics, artificial intelligence, data ecosystems, and customer experience measurement. Share knowledge with other consultants and help strengthen the capabilities of the wider Professional Services team.   What you’ll need to succeed Approximately 5 to 6 years of experience in management consulting, strategic consulting, digital consulting, professional services, or a similar customer-facing advisory environment. Experience working with large enterprise customers and navigating complex stakeholder environments. Demonstrated experience managing projects or workstreams from discovery through delivery. Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills, including the ability to lead workshops and executive discussions. Structured thinking and strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to frame ambiguous customer challenges clearly. Practical experience with digital analytics, business intelligence, conversion optimization, customer experience analytics, or related data products. Familiarity with digital analytics platforms such as Google Analytics or Adobe Analytics. Experience with Contentsquare is highly valuable. Understanding of tagging plans, data collection, data quality, measurement frameworks, data structures, and the limitations that can affect analytical outcomes. Ability to interpret data, develop an analysis, and communicate the implications and recommendations clearly. Ability to work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders. Strong project management skills, including planning, prioritization, risk management, stakeholder coordination, and escalation. Ability to work independently across a changing mix of one-off missions and recurring managed-services engagements. Comfortable collaborating with Customer Success, Sales, Data Analysts, UX Design Consultants, Implementation Managers, and other specialist teams. Practical curiosity about artificial intelligence, data flows, data warehouses, data lakes, APIs, and modern digital analytics ecosystems. Ability to use AI tools thoughtfully to improve your own work and customer delivery, while applying appropriate judgment and maintaining confidentiality. Full professional fluency in French and English, including the ability to lead customer conversations, workshops, and presentations in French. Availability to work with customers primarily during French or Central European business hours. Willingness to travel occasionally for customer engagements, team meetings, and company events.
