Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. 

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach. 

We have offices in Paris and London and we offer remote working from Germany, France and the United Kingdom.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, and the United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara's mission.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will: 

  • Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and LinkedIn
  • Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and in French

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in closing-sales roles
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

  • ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
  • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.
  • The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. 

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach. 

We have offices in Paris and London and we offer remote working from Germany, France and the United Kingdom.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, and the United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara's mission.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will: 

  • Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and LinkedIn
  • Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.
  • Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling
  • Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles
  • 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum
  • Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
  • Curious and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and in French

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in closing-sales roles
  • Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space

ADR pathways

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.

  • ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.
  • The next level in the program is ADR II, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.
  • The highest level within our organization is ADR III. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

raw.title: Supply Chain Planner (all genders) - PARIS - CDD
raw.description:
About this role

  • Warehouse coordination: You are the main point of contact for day-to-day operations with the EU HUB warehouse, fostering a collaborative and efficient working relationship.
  • Order management: You oversee the preparation of customer orders and track shipments for a diverse client base — including 3PLs, agents, distributors and subsidiaries — and set priorities.
  • Delivery tracking: You coordinate order pickup with carriers (EU/non-EU) and track invoicing.
  • Customer service: You act as a key point of contact for customer service, ensuring responsive, high-quality support, and manage order discrepancies.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: You maintain clear and effective communication with internal teams (Logistics, Finance, Customer Service, Demand Planning) to ensure smooth operational processes.
  • Inbound management: You coordinate deliveries with the US and China, freight forwarders, customs and the EU HUB warehouse, and monitor carrier invoicing.


About you

  • Experience: At least 2 years of experience in supply planning and managing international shipments.
  • Proactive mindset: A forward-thinking, proactive approach to staying on top of emerging topics and challenges.
  • Language skills: Fluency in English and French required; German is a plus.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Demonstrated ability to work effectively with finance, logistics and sales teams.
  • Performance- and improvement-oriented.


Why us?

  • The opportunity to join a global leader in professional skin care and contribute to a meaningful mission.
  • A dynamic culture where you become a full part of the Tribe and your contribution matters.
  • International exposure and cross-functional collaborations across Europe.
  • Ongoing training and professional development opportunities within the Unilever Prestige group.
  • Navigo transit pass reimbursed at 50%
  • Meal vouchers: Swile cardCompetitive compensation and benefits aligned with the market and the group's standards.

raw.title: Commercial(e) Terrain
raw.description:
Vous aimez vendre, convaincre et aller directement à la rencontre de vos clients ?

Chez SumUp, nous aidons les commerçants du quotidien à développer leur activité grâce à des solutions de paiement et de gestion simples, accessibles et performantes.

Dans le cadre de notre croissance en France, nous recherchons un(e) commercial(e) terrain prêt(e) à partir à la conquête de nouveaux clients. Il s'agit d'un poste 100 % terrain : vous rencontrez directement les commerçants de votre secteur, identifiez leurs besoins, leur présentez nos solutions et les accompagnez jusqu'à la signature.

Votre rémunération

Nous faisons le choix de la transparence dès le début du processus :

  • 30 000 € bruts annuels de salaire fixe
  • 27 600 € bruts annuels de variable cible, à 100 % des objectifs
  • Soit un package cible de 57 600 € bruts annuels
  • Un variable entièrement déplafonné (à titre d'exemple, les commerciaux les plus performants peuvent dépasser 100 000 € bruts de rémunération annuelle totale)

Les modalités précises du plan de commissionnement vous seront présentées pendant le processus de recrutement.

 

Vos missions

  • Prospecter directement les commerçants de votre secteur : restaurateurs, artisans, indépendants et commerces de proximité
  • Comprendre leurs besoins et leur présenter les solutions SumUp les plus adaptées
  • Réaliser des démonstrations claires et convaincantes de nos produits
  • Négocier et conclure vos ventes directement sur le terrain
  • Gérer l'intégralité du cycle de vente, du premier contact jusqu'à la signature
  • Développer durablement votre secteur grâce à une prospection régulière et structurée
  • Suivre vos résultats et ajuster votre approche pour atteindre et dépasser vos objectifs

Ce que nous vous proposons

  • Une formation complète et régulière à nos produits et à nos méthodes de vente
  • Un accompagnement de proximité pour développer rapidement vos compétences commerciales
  • Une grande autonomie dans l'organisation et le développement de votre secteur
  • Un environnement dynamique, international et orienté vers la performance
  • Une opportunité de rejoindre le secteur de la tech et de la fintech
  • Des perspectives d'évolution vers des fonctions commerciales seniors ou d'encadrement

Ce poste est fait pour vous si

  • Vous avez déjà une expérience concrète de la prospection à froid, idéalement sur le terrain
  • Vous êtes à l'aise pour aborder des prospects qui ne connaissent pas encore SumUp et susciter leur intérêt
  • Vous aimez la vente terrain, la prospection directe et le contact humain
  • Vous savez créer rapidement une relation de confiance
  • Vous faites preuve d'aisance orale, d'énergie et de force de conviction
  • Vous savez rebondir face aux objections et rester motivé(e) dans un environnement exigeant
  • Vous êtes autonome, organisé(e), persévérant(e) et orienté(e) vers les résultats
  • Vous aimez les objectifs ambitieux et souhaitez avoir un impact direct sur votre rémunération
  • Vous parlez couramment français et disposez d'un niveau d'anglais vous permettant de participer à des échanges internes

Une expérience préalable en prospection à froid est indispensable pour réussir dans ce poste.

Vos avantages

En complément de votre rémunération, vous bénéficiez notamment de :

  • 25 jours de congés payés, auxquels s'ajoutent les jours fériés et des jours de congé spéciaux offerts par SumUp (anniversaire, déménagement...)
  • Break4Me : un mois de congé sabbatique entièrement rémunéré après trois ans d'ancienneté
  • Titres-restaurant de 12 € par jour travaillé
  • Une solution de mobilité adaptée à votre situation : allocation mobilité/véhicule de 400 € via Betterway remboursement à 100 % de votre abonnement aux transports publics ou budget de mobilité douce de 600 € par an
  • Indemnité téléphonique de 30 €
  • Indemnité Internet de 36 €
  • Mutuelle d'entreprise
  • Accès à Wellpass, avec une participation de SumUp, pour vos activités sportives et de bien-être
  • Accès à notre plateforme CE d'avantages salariés
  • Consultations médicales à distance gratuites avec Livi
  • Accès aux services de La Maison Bleue
  • Accompagnement proposé par Action Logement
  • Programme de recommandation interne
  • Des opportunités régulières de formation, d'apprentissage et de développement professionnel

Processus de recrutement

  1. Échange avec un recruteur – Discussion sur votre parcours et vos motivations
  2. Entretien avec le manager – Approfondissement de vos compétences et de votre compréhension du rôle
  3. Mise en situation commerciale – Exercice pratique permettant d'évaluer votre approche de la vente terrain

À propos de SumUp

Chez SumUp, nous soutenons les commerçants du quotidien : artisans, restaurateurs, indépendants et commerces de proximité. Nos solutions leur permettent d'accepter facilement les paiements, de gérer leur activité et de se concentrer sur ce qu'ils font de mieux.

Plus de 3 000 collaborateurs issus de 93 nationalités contribuent aujourd'hui à cette mission. Guidés par nos valeurs — Founder's Mentality, Team First et We Care — nous travaillons ensemble pour simplifier le quotidien des petites entreprises.

SumUp est un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances. Nous valorisons la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des profils.

Un dernier conseil

Vous avez une expérience en prospection à froid, mais ne cochez pas tous les autres critères ? Postulez quand même.

Votre potentiel, votre motivation, votre capacité à apprendre et votre envie de réussir peuvent faire toute la différence.

Prêt(e) à transformer chaque rencontre en opportunité et à développer votre secteur avec SumUp ? Postulez dès maintenant et venez construire la suite de votre réussite commerciale avec nous.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

We develop the full quantum computing stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic processors to control systems, software and applications. Our ambition is to build fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of solving problems beyond the reach of classical computation. The role: We are looking for an AI Scientist to join Quandela’s AI and Quantum Machine Learning team in Massy (near Paris) You will develop and evaluate machine-learning approaches for quantum computing, covering both: AI for quantum systems , including calibration, control, decoding for quantum error correction; quantum and hybrid machine learning , including rigorous comparisons with state-of-the-art classical methods, using MerLin, Quandela's framework for quantum machine learning. You will work on research with colleagues across AI, quantum algorithms, software, product and hardware. The Massy team is a central part of Quandela’s AI activities. This role therefore offers significant ownership and the opportunity to help shape and grow the team over time. What You'll Do: Design, implement and train machine-learning and quantum machine-learning models. Develop AI methods to improve the calibration, control and performance of quantum systems. Benchmark classical, quantum and hybrid methods using meaningful baselines and evaluation metrics. Contribute actively to the development of the MerLin framework. Contribute to publications and collaborations with academic partners, including research ecosystem. Present your work internally and at scientific conferences and technical events. Help define Quandela’s future AI research directions and mentor junior researchers as the team grows. Requirements What we are looking for: We are looking for an AI scientist, or an experienced industry practitioner with an equivalent background, who is eager to apply state-of-the-art classical machine-learning methods to scientific and engineering challenges in quantum computing. The role is primarily focused on using AI to improve quantum technologies, while also providing opportunities to develop and investigate quantum and hybrid machine-learning models. PhD + 3 years of experience or equivalent industrial R&D experience in machine learning. Strong foundations in modern machine learning, experimental methodology and model evaluation. Excellent scientific programming skills, particularly in Python and common machine-learning frameworks. Experience taking research ideas from initial exploration to robust implementation. Interest in working on both longer term research and concrete product problems. Strong communication skills and the ability to work autonomously within a focused, multidisciplinary team. Professional fluency in English. Bonus Points Previous experience applying AI to physical systems, scientific computing, hardware control or experimental data. Knowledge of quantum computing, quantum machine learning or photonic quantum technologies. Experience mentoring junior researchers or helping define technical research directions. We develop the full quantum computing stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic processors to control systems, software and applications. Our platforms are available through the cloud and as on-premises systems.

Our ambition is to build fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of solving problems beyond the reach of classical computation.

The role:

We are looking for an AI Scientist to join Quandela’s AI and Quantum Machine Learning team in Massy (near Paris)

You will develop and evaluate machine-learning approaches for quantum computing, covering both:

  • AI for quantum systems, including calibration, control, decoding for quantum error correction;
  • quantum and hybrid machine learning, including rigorous comparisons with state-of-the-art classical methods, using MerLin, Quandela's framework for quantum machine learning.

You will work on research with colleagues across AI, quantum algorithms, software, product and hardware.

The Massy team is a central part of Quandela’s AI activities. This role therefore offers significant ownership and the opportunity to help shape and grow the team over time.

What You'll Do:

  • Design, implement and train machine-learning and quantum machine-learning models.
  • Develop AI methods to improve the calibration, control and performance of quantum systems.
  • Benchmark classical, quantum and hybrid methods using meaningful baselines and evaluation metrics.
  • Contribute actively to the development of the MerLin framework.
  • Contribute to publications and collaborations with academic partners, including research ecosystem.
  • Present your work internally and at scientific conferences and technical events.
  • Help define Quandela’s future AI research directions and mentor junior researchers as the team grows.

Requirements

What we are looking for:

We are looking for an AI scientist, or an experienced industry practitioner with an equivalent background, who is eager to apply state-of-the-art classical machine-learning methods to scientific and engineering challenges in quantum computing. The role is primarily focused on using AI to improve quantum technologies, while also providing opportunities to develop and investigate quantum and hybrid machine-learning models.

  • PhD + 3 years of experience or equivalent industrial R&D experience in machine learning.
  • Strong foundations in modern machine learning, experimental methodology and model evaluation.
  • Excellent scientific programming skills, particularly in Python and common machine-learning frameworks.
  • Experience taking research ideas from initial exploration to robust implementation.
  • Interest in working on both longer term research and concrete product problems.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work autonomously within a focused, multidisciplinary team.
  • Professional fluency in English.

Bonus Points

  • Previous experience applying AI to physical systems, scientific computing, hardware control or experimental data.
  • Knowledge of quantum computing, quantum machine learning or photonic quantum technologies.
  • Experience mentoring junior researchers or helping define technical research directions.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience and expectations
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

Process: 

  • Talent Acquisition Interview (30' - 45') 
  • Hiring Manager Interview (45' - 60') 
  • Reference checks 
  • Technical discussion and presentation of previous research work 
  • Meeting with the team
  • Offer 


Beyond That:
At Quandela, we value scientific curiosity, experimentation and collaboration. If you're passionate about quantum optics, spin physics and quantum technologies, we'd love to hear from you, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. 

If you're excited by the challenge of turning scientific ideas into demonstrations, advancing the building blocks of future quantum computing systems and working alongside physicists, engineers and theorists, let's talk.

raw.description:
Retail Manager - Travel Retail, Northern Europe

12 Month FTC

About Charlotte Tilbury Beauty

Founded by British makeup artist and beauty entrepreneur Charlotte Tilbury CBE in 2013, Charlotte Tilbury Beauty has revolutionised the face of the global beauty industry by de-coding makeup applications for everyone, everywhere, with an easy-to-use, easy-to-choose, easy-to-gift range. Today, Charlotte Tilbury Beauty continues to break records across countries, channels, and categories and to scale at pace.

Over the last 10 years, Charlotte Tilbury Beauty has experienced exceptional growth and is one of the most talked about brands in the beauty industry and beyond. It has become a global sensation across 50 markets (and growing), with over 2,300 employees globally who are part of the Dream Team making the magic happen.

Today, Charlotte Tilbury Beauty is a truly global business, delivering market-leading growth, innovative retail and product launches fuelled by industry-leading tech — all with an internal culture of embracing challenges, disruptive thinking, winning together, and sharing the magic. The energy behind the bran­d is infectious, and as we grow, we are always looking for extraordinary talent who want to be part of this our success and help drive our limitless ambitions.

About the role

We’re looking for an ambitious and experienced Retail Manager to join our fabulous, newly appointed Travel Retail team, focusing on the Northern Europe region.  

Responsibilities include building retailer relationships, identifying commercial opportunities, leading a field team comprising of store-based business managers and retail artists and managing corresponding budgets, showcasing strong budget management capability and being confident in retail sales forecasting, reporting and data analysis. 

KPIs are retail sales achievement, market share gains, mystery shopping score and team turnover. 

As a Retail Manager you will

Sales Objectives and Market Share Gains

  • Define development and growth strategies with the Head of Travel Retail, Europe for the designated accounts and implement them successfully in stores. 
  • Deliver sell-out in line with forecast commitments. 
  • Identify and capitalise on opportunities to drive brand awareness, performance, and market share across the region. 

Account Management

  • Build strong relationships with retailer contacts to optimise brand presence, maximize share of voice, and negotiate industry-leading joint trading plans. 
  • Deliver regular business/sales updates and critical market insights, acting as the connection between our stores and the Magic Office. 
  • Lead quarterly business reviews and half-year external strategy meetings, producing strong insights and action-driven 360 plans. 

High Performance Teams

  • With the people partner, recruit high performing Retail teams for each store launch. 
  • Set ambitious and achievable sales targets to the field teams. 
  • Lead and inspire your team of business managers and retail artists. 
  • When needed, address performance and engagement needs identified, building an environment of inclusion and motivation within your defined area.  
  • Work alongside the field training manager to ensure commercial and development training needs are met within the region. 

Brand Image Building and Launch of New Campaigns

  • Work in close collaboration with Travel Retail Marketing & VM teams to develop trade plans and on-counter activities. 
  • Successfully launch and sustain new products and campaigns as per the global Travel Retail Marketing strategy.  

 Effective Commercial & Budget Management

  • With the Head of Travel Retail, Europe, monthly retail forecasting by store.  
  • In alignment with finance and retailer partners, forecast and manage all retail staffing costs, including recommended FTEs, commissions and incentives management.  
  • Manage T&E budget, staying within approved monthly expenditure.  

Operational Excellence

  • Set standards for executional excellence, support new processes, and work cross-functionally to enhance brand presentation and in-store execution, including but not limited to assortment, stock availability on counter, price updates. 

Requirements

  • Must be able to travel within region and to Magic Office regularly. Roughly a 40/60 split
  • Wide experience in Retail or Sales Management, with direct experience in Travel Retail desirable but not mandatory
  • Strong people focus, team spirited and passionate about developing teams. 
  • Proven track record of successful negotiations & ability to influence others. 
  • Target-focused and results-driven. 
  • Excellent numerical and analytical skills. 
  • Effective communicator, both written and verbal with a structured and organised approach 
  • Excellent presentation skills and classroom delivery 
  • Personable and approachable; able to build rapport quickly & effectively 
  • Self-starter; able to motivate oneself and others 
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing priorities. Agility is key!  
  • Solution-oriented with ability to problem solve in a timely manner 
  • French language is mandatory 

Charlotte Tilbury is a fast-paced and dynamic environment where nimble mindsets, striving to deliver the best and wanting to be part of a global #dreaamteam are key. Even though we have requirements, our experience and background are just a guide, we still love to welcome applicants with more or less experience stated, provided necessary skills can be demonstrated.

Benefits

  • Be a part of this values driven, high growth, magical journey with an ultimate vision to empower everyone, everywhere to be the best version of themselves
  • 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays) with an additional day to celebrate your birthday
  • Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents and carers throughout their parenting and caring journey
  • Financial security and planning with our pension and life assurance for all
  • Wellness and social benefits including Medicash, Employee Assist Programs and regular social connects with colleagues
  • And not to forget our generous product discount and gifting!

At Charlotte Tilbury Beauty, our mission is to empower everybody in the world to be the most beautiful version of themselves. We celebrate and support this by encouraging and hiring people with diverse backgrounds, cultures, voices, beliefs, and perspectives into our growing global workforce. By doing so, we better serve our communities, customers, employees - and the candidates that take part in our recruitment process.

If you want to learn more about life at Charlotte Tilbury Beauty please follow our LinkedIn page!

title: Wireless Networking Engineer
description: Chez Exotec, nous mettons l’excellence technologique au service de la redéfinition des relations entre humains et robots. A travers le monde, nos solutions révolutionnent la façon dont nos client·e·s délivrent leurs produits aux personnes consommatrices finales. Nous contribuons au succès des plus grandes marques du commerce et de l’industrie, tout en améliorant les conditions de travail de leurs salarié·e·s. Par l’alliance de l’intelligence artificielle et d’un hardware performant, nos robots sont désormais déployés dans le monde entier et leur succès a fait de nous la première licorne industrielle française. Rejoindre Exotec, c’est l’opportunité de donner du sens à vos compétences. Grandissez avec nos ExoPeople dans le monde entier pour faire de vos idées, des réalités. La révolution robotique portée par Exotec ne fait que commencer, vous en êtes ? Nous recherchons un.e Wireless Networking Engineer pour rejoindre notre équipe R&D et prendre la responsabilité de la couche de connectivité qui alimente notre flotte de robots. Vous travaillerez à l'intersection de la robotique, du WiFi, des réseaux, du logiciel et de la performance des systèmes afin de garantir des communications robustes dans des environnements complexes, à forte densité et comportant de multiples clients connectés. En tant qu'Ingénieur.e Réseaux Sans Fil, vous serez chargé.e de concevoir, surveiller, analyser et améliorer la solution de connectivité sans fil utilisée par les robots Exotec. Vous enquêterez, diagnostiquerez et optimiserez les infrastructures WiFi et les ressources réseau TCP/IP dans des déploiements à grande échelle, où des centaines de robots mobiles évoluent en permanence au sein d'une infrastructure sans fil tout en maintenant une communication fiable et à faible latence avec les services backend. Votre travail aura un impact direct sur la performance de la flotte, la disponibilité du système et l'expérience client. Missions : Concevoir, superviser et optimiser la connectivité WiFi des robots Exotec. Analyser et résoudre les problèmes de performance réseau (WiFi, TCP/IP, roaming, latence, pertes de paquets, interférences RF) Développer des outils et méthodologies de diagnostic, de monitoring et d'analyse des performances. Améliorer la fiabilité des communications des robots autonomes en collaboration avec les équipes Software et Systèmes. Définir les KPI et les stratégies de supervision de la connectivité de la flotte. Participer au développement des couches logicielles de connectivité embarquée (C/C++). Concevoir et réaliser des campagnes de tests et de validation en laboratoire et sur le terrain. Apporter une expertise réseau avancée lors des investigations clients et des déploiements. Profil : Diplôme de niveau Master (Bac+5) ou équivalent en informatique, télécommunications, réseaux, systèmes embarqués ou domaine connexe. Minimum 3 ans d'expérience en réseaux, communications sans fil, systèmes embarqués ou domaines similaires. Excellente maîtrise des fondamentaux des réseaux TCP/IP. Bonne connaissance des normes IEEE 802.11, notamment : 802.11ac (WiFi 5) ; 802.11ax (WiFi 6) ; WPA2 / WPA3 Expérience dans le diagnostic de problèmes réseau complexes à l'aide d'outils de capture de paquets et d'analyse de protocoles. Aisance dans les environnements Linux. Expérience des tests de performance réseau, de l'observabilité et des systèmes de supervision. Goût prononcé pour la compréhension du comportement des systèmes dans des environnements réels. Capacité à intervenir aussi bien sur les aspects logiciels, réseaux que matériels. Approche de résolution de problèmes basée sur les données. Capacité à évoluer dans une organisation d'ingénierie en forte croissance et très collaborative. Benefits Couverture mutuelle et prévoyance santé compétitive Politique famille avantageuse Programme de mobilité interne et internationale Nombreuses opportunités de formation et de développement   Chez Exotec, nous garantissons l’égalité des chances dans notre processus de recrutement. L’ensemble des candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’âge, du genre, de l’origine, de la religion, de la couleur de peau, de la nationalité, du sexe, du handicap, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de toute autre distinction protégée par la loi. Nous mettons en place un environnement de travail inclusif et respectueux de toutes les différences. En rejoignant le Pacte Parité, Exotec s’engage pour un écosystème French Tech plus paritaire. Rattaché(e) au Digital Workplace Manager, vous rejoignez une équipe IT de 7 personnes. Votre périmètre couvre deux dimensions complémentaires : l'administration des environnements cloud et la gestion de l'infrastructure réseau interne. Ce rôle s'inscrit dans une organisation IT structurée, avec de vraies responsabilités techniques dès votre prise de poste. Le Challenge Exotec opère dans un environnement multi-cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) en constante évolution, au service de plus de 1 300 collaborateurs répartis dans le monde. La maîtrise de cette infrastructure est un enjeu de continuité et de performance pour l'ensemble de l'entreprise. Votre défi : Prise en main de l'infrastructure: Acquérir une compréhension complète et approfondie de nos environnements cloud et réseau pour gagner rapidement en autonomie Optimisation des environnements: Identifier les axes d'amélioration et contribuer activement à la rationalisation et la performance de l'infra existante Être force de proposition pour faire évoluer l'infrastructure dans le bon sens, en anticipant les besoins plutôt qu'en subissant les contraintes Collaboration transverse : Tisser des relations de confiance avec les équipes internes pour mieux anticiper et répondre à leurs besoins Missions principales 1. Optimisation et amélioration continue Vous analysez les environnements en place, proposez des pistes d'optimisation (coût, performance, résilience) et participez activement à leur mise en œuvre en lien avec l'équipe. 2. Support au déploiement applicatif Vous accompagnez les équipes de développement dans le déploiement de leurs applications sur Kubernetes, en assurant le lien entre les besoins applicatifs et les contraintes d'infrastructure. 3. Administration et fiabilité des environnements cloud Vous assurez l'exploitation, la supervision et la maintenance des infrastructures Azure et AWS. Vous êtes garant(e) de leur disponibilité et de leur performance au quotidien. 4. Infrastructure réseau Vous pilotez l'installation et le maintien en condition opérationnelle de l'infrastructure réseau sur l'ensemble des sites Exotec. Vous prenez en charge la configuration et la gestion du matériel d'interconnexion (routeurs, switches, bornes Wi-Fi Huawei/Unifi) et garantissez la qualité et la continuité des connexions pour l'ensemble des collaborateurs. 5. Sécurité de l'infrastructure Vous appliquez et faites évoluer les bonnes pratiques de sécurité sur l'ensemble du périmètre : durcissement des configurations, gestion des accès privilégiés, et vigilance sur les vecteurs de risque courants. 6. Gestion des incidents & continuité de service Vous assurez la prise en charge et l'escalade des incidents d'infrastructure, en veillant à la rapidité et à la qualité de résolution. Poste basé à Wasquehal.

Rattaché(e) au Digital Workplace Manager, vous rejoignez une équipe IT de 7 personnes.
Votre périmètre couvre deux dimensions complémentaires : l'administration des environnements cloud et la gestion de l'infrastructure réseau interne. Vous garantissez la disponibilité, la performance et la sécurité des systèmes qui font tourner le quotidien de l'ensemble des collaborateurs Exotec. Vous êtes l'interlocuteur(trice) privilégié(e) des équipes DSI, mais également des équipes Produit pour tout ce qui touche aux besoins d'infrastructure.
Ce rôle s'inscrit dans une organisation IT structurée, avec de vraies responsabilités techniques dès votre prise de poste.

Le Challenge
Exotec opère dans un environnement multi-cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) en constante évolution, au service de plus de 1 300 collaborateurs répartis dans le monde. La maîtrise de cette infrastructure est un enjeu de continuité et de performance pour l'ensemble de l'entreprise.
Votre défi :

  • Prise en main de l'infrastructure: Acquérir une compréhension complète et approfondie de nos environnements cloud et réseau pour gagner rapidement en autonomie
  • Optimisation des environnements: Identifier les axes d'amélioration et contribuer activement à la rationalisation et la performance de l'infra existante
  • Être force de proposition pour faire évoluer l'infrastructure dans le bon sens, en anticipant les besoins plutôt qu'en subissant les contraintes
  • Collaboration transverse : Tisser des relations de confiance avec les équipes internes pour mieux anticiper et répondre à leurs besoins


Missions principales

1. Optimisation et amélioration continue
Vous analysez les environnements en place, proposez des pistes d'optimisation (coût, performance, résilience) et participez activement à leur mise en œuvre en lien avec l'équipe.

2. Support au déploiement applicatif
Vous accompagnez les équipes de développement dans le déploiement de leurs applications sur Kubernetes, en assurant le lien entre les besoins applicatifs et les contraintes d'infrastructure.

3. Administration et fiabilité des environnements cloud
Vous assurez l'exploitation, la supervision et la maintenance des infrastructures Azure et AWS. Vous êtes garant(e) de leur disponibilité et de leur performance au quotidien.
4. Infrastructure réseau
Vous pilotez l'installation et le maintien en condition opérationnelle de l'infrastructure réseau sur l'ensemble des sites Exotec. Vous prenez en charge la configuration et la gestion du matériel d'interconnexion (routeurs, switches, bornes Wi-Fi Huawei/Unifi) et garantissez la qualité et la continuité des connexions pour l'ensemble des collaborateurs.
5. Sécurité de l'infrastructure
Vous appliquez et faites évoluer les bonnes pratiques de sécurité sur l'ensemble du périmètre : durcissement des configurations, gestion des accès privilégiés, et vigilance sur les vecteurs de risque courants.
6. Gestion des incidents & continuité de service
Vous assurez la prise en charge et l'escalade des incidents d'infrastructure, en veillant à la rapidité et à la qualité de résolution. Vous contribuez à la définition et au maintien des dispositifs de continuité (PRA/PCA) pour garantir la résilience des services IT.
7. Documentation et capitalisation
Vous maintenez une documentation technique à jour et de qualité, afin de garantir la lisibilité de l'infrastructure et faciliter la collaboration au sein de l'équipe IT.

Requirements

Expérience

  • +3 ans d'expérience sur un poste similaire, idéalement dans un environnement multi-cloud
  • Expérience concrète sur des infrastructures Azure et/ou AWS en production


Compétences techniques

  • Maîtrise d'Azure et AWS (administration, IAM, réseaux virtuels, monitoring)
  • Solides bases en réseau : VLAN, Firewall, LAN/WAN, routage, VPN (IPSec/OpenVPN)
  • Solides bases en Linux
  • IaC / DevOps : Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD, Gitlab
  • Notions de sécurité infrastructure (durcissement, gestion des accès, bonnes pratiques cloud)


Soft skills

  • Autonomie et rigueur dans la gestion de son périmètre
  • Curiosité technique et appétence pour l'amélioration continue
  • Bonne communication, à l'aise dans un environnement multi-équipes

raw.title: (Senior) Social Brand Manager (all genders)
raw.description:
They do 08/15. We create 9:16

Wir schaffen Relevanz, um Aufmerksamkeit zu erreichen und zu skalieren.

Sichtbarkeit ist nicht automatisch Relevanz. Reichweite nicht automatisch Wirkung.

WeCreate ist eine Social-First Brand Building Agency für das Interest-Media-Zeitalter. Wir übersetzen Social Signals und Community Insights in Social Strategien, Content-Systeme und messbare Markenwirkung als strategischer Partner, Campaign Co-Pilot oder operatives Umsetzungsteam. 

Für Marken, die nicht nur stattfinden, sondern kulturell und in ihren Communities relevant sein wollen, suchen wir dich als (Senior) Social Brand Manager (all genders).

Du verbindest strategische Beratung mit sicherem Account Management und konsequenter operativer Steuerung. Als verlängerter Arm unserer Kund:innen und strategische Stimme von WeCreate sorgst du dafür, dass aus Plattform- und Community-Signalen klare Entscheidungen, relevante Aktivierungen und messbare Markenwirkung werden.


Deine Rolle

Du verantwortest eigenständig Kund:innen Etats im Daily Business und führst sie sicher durch ihr Full-Social-System. Dabei steuerst du sowohl strategisch als auch operativ: von der Plattformstrategie und Aktivierungsplanung über Content, Community und Creator bis hin zu Performance, Budget und Wirtschaftlichkeit.

Du denkst Social nicht in einzelnen Gewerken, sondern als integriertes System. Du hältst Markenführung, kreative Qualität, operative Umsetzung, Paid Media und Business-Ziele zusammen mit klarer Haltung, strukturiertem Account Management und einem sicheren Gespür dafür, was auf Plattformen und in Communities funktioniert.


Dein Impact bei WeCreate

Du agierst als verlängerter Arm deiner Kund:innen und zugleich als strategische Stimme von WeCreate. Du schaffst Orientierung, wenn Plattformen, Trends und Anforderungen in Bewegung sind, und hältst Markenambition, kreative Exzellenz, operative Umsetzung und wirtschaftliche Ziele zusammen.

Du bist mehr als Schnittstelle: Du erkennst, was eine Marke jetzt braucht, übersetzt es in klare Social-Maßnahmen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Kund:innen Systeme, die langfristig Relevanz aufbauen und Wachstum ermöglichen.


Das erwartet dich:

  • Strategisches Account Management: Du führst Kund:innen eigenständig auf Senior-Level, berätst sie zur ganzheitlichen Full-Social-Präsenz und baust langfristige Partnerschaften auf.
  • Strategische und operative Steuerung: Du übersetzt Marken- und Business-Ziele in klare Social-Strategien, Aktivierungspläne und priorisierte To-dos – auch über mehrere Projekte hinweg.
  • Channel Ownership: Du entwickelst plattformgerechte Strategien und stellst sicher, dass Inhalte zu Marke, Zielgruppe, Community und Plattformlogik passen.
  • Projekt-, Produktions- und Content-Steuerung: Du verantwortest Social-Aktivierungen, Redaktionsplanung und Produktionen von der Konzeption bis zur Freigabe. Dabei sicherst du markenkonsistenten, plattformnativen Content mit klarer Wirkungserwartung.
  • Creator- und Community-Management: Du steuerst Creator-Kooperationen ganzheitlich – von Auswahl und Verhandlung bis zu Briefing und Auswertung. Community-Learnings und kulturelle Signale übersetzt du in relevante Empfehlungen.
  • Performance-, Budget- und Paid-Media-Kompetenz: Du interpretierst Daten, leitest konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab, steuerst Budgets und Wirtschaftlichkeit und integrierst Paid Media in deine Full-Funnel-Beratung.
  • Fachliches Sparring und Systementwicklung: Du entwickelst Standards für Creator Management, Measurement und AI-gestützte Prozesse weiter, bringst dein Wissen ins Team ein und stärkst Strategie- und Creative-Kompetenz.


Das bringst du mit:

Das sind deine Kernkompetenzen

  • Du kannst komplexe Marken- und Business-Ziele in klare Social-Strategien, Prioritäten und umsetzbare Pläne übersetzen.

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Führung anspruchsvoller Kund:innenetats oder Retainer – von Beratung und Planung bis Umsetzung, Performance-Review und Weiterentwicklung.

  • Du beherrschst Full Social: Plattformstrategie, Content-Systeme, Community, Creator und Paid Media gehören für dich zu einer wirksamen Markenführung zusammen.

  • Du steuerst Projekte, Budgets, Aufwände und Stakeholder vorausschauend und kannst wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge in klare Entscheidungen übersetzen.

  • Du bringst Erfahrung im Creator Management mit – inklusive Auswahl, Verhandlung, Briefing, Steuerung, Qualitätskontrolle und Auswertung.

  • Du kannst Daten und Reportings analytisch einordnen, strategische Implikationen ableiten und Handlungsempfehlungen klar vermitteln.

  • Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Marken, Content und Plattformkultur und kannst kreative Qualität konstruktiv, verbindlich und auf Augenhöhe führen.


So arbeitest du

  • Du kommunizierst klar, verbindlich und verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch sowie sicher auf Englisch.

  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und proaktiv – auch wenn sich Prioritäten, Plattformen oder Anforderungen verändern.

  • Du erkennst früh, wo Abstimmung oder Steuerung nötig ist, und handelst entsprechend – mit Kund:innen, Creator:innen und im Team.

  • Du hältst strategische Prioritäten auch bei hohem Tempo im Blick und schaffst Orientierung, wenn viele Themen gleichzeitig laufen.

  • Du hast Freude daran, Wissen zu teilen, Kolleg:innen fachlich zu sparren und Arbeitsweisen gemeinsam weiterzuentwickeln.


Das bekommst du bei uns:

Flexibilität mit Verbindung

  • Hybrides Arbeiten mit unserem Office in Hamburg als Team-Hub

  • Mindestens fünf Tage pro Monat gemeinsames Arbeiten im Office für integrierte Teamarbeit

  • Flexibles Arbeiten von zuhause und wenn du Lust auf einen Perspektivwechsel hast, nach Absprache zeitweise aus dem Ausland

  • Flexibilität für Produktionen, Workshops, Kundentermine und Offsite-Formate

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine Arbeitsweise, die zu deinem Alltag passt

  • Freie Wahl deiner Hardware


Benefits, die dir wirklich etwas bringen

  • Gemeinsame Events und Workations, weil gute Zusammenarbeit nicht nur im Kalender entsteht

  • Wahlweise Zuschuss zum ÖPNV-Ticket, Probonio-Gutschein oder Urban Sports Club

  • Bagel-Frühstück im Office für einen gemeinsamen Start in den Tag


Und sonst?

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege, viel Eigenverantwortung und Vertrauen in deine Expertise

  • Eine steile Lernkurve – ohne Dauer-Überstunden als vermeintliches Karriereprogramm

  • Raum, eine wachsende Agentur und unsere Arbeitsweisen aktiv mitzugestalten

  • Flache Hierarchien sowie ein respektvoller, offener Umgang miteinander


Hinweis zur Anstellung:

Die Stelle ist zunächst auf zwei Jahre befristet – mit Option auf Verlängerung bzw. Übernahme in ein unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis.

Dann bewirb dich über unser Karriereportal:

https://wecreate-germany-gmbh.jobs.personio.de/

WeCreate möchte einen inklusiven, diversen und authentischen Arbeitsplatz schaffen. Vielleicht bist genau du die Person, die diese Rolle weiterdenkt. Wir freuen uns, dich kennenzulernen.

description: <p>The Security Libraries team owns the customer-side integrations behind Datadog’s run-time security products — <a href="https://www.datadoghq.com/product/app-and-api-protection/">App &amp; API Protection</a>, <a href="https://www.datadoghq.com/product/workload-protection/">Workload Protection</a>, and <a href="https://www.datadoghq.com/product/code-security/">Code Security</a> — shipping and maintaining security capabilities across seven open-source language libraries (<a href="https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-dotnet">.NET</a>, <a href="https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-java">Java</a>, <a href="https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-go">Go</a>, <a href="https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js">Node.js</a>, <a href="https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-py">Python</a>, <a href="https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-rb">Ruby</a>, <a href="https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-php">PHP</a>) and a set of HTTP proxy integrations (Envoy, NGINX, and HAProxy), running inside thousands of production clusters worldwide.</p> <p>Recent work spans exploit prevention (RASP), WAF detections, API Security, code security (IAST and SCA), and AI-assisted onboarding. As Engineering Manager, you’ll lead part of this polyglot team, setting the technical bar and team culture while driving the pace at which new detections and AI-assisted capabilities reach customers. This is a hands-on role: you’ll balance people leadership, product and roadmap ownership, and the operational health of code that runs in production at massive scale, with room to grow into more of Datadog’s security portfolio over time.</p> <p><em>At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.</em></p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead, grow, and develop a team of roughly 4-8 library engineers — coaching, giving direct feedback, and empowering senior ICs as technical leaders</li> <li>Own team delivery and productivity: planning, milestones, reviews, and the on-call rotation</li> <li>Set product direction with Product Management and balance priorities across App &amp; API Protection, Workload Protection, and Code Security</li> <li>Stay technically close to the work — apply strong technical judgment, contribute code where it matters most, and keep quality and architecture high</li> <li>Build strong relationships and drive alignment across the language teams and product, backend, and frontend partners</li> <li>Shape team identity and culture, and own accountability when problems occur</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience managing a team of engineers — setting direction with Product Managers, owning a backlog, and running delivery</li> <li>A senior software-engineering background with strong technical judgment</li> <li>A track record developing people: coaching, direct feedback, and helping engineers, both senior and struggling, grow</li> <li>Strong cross-team communication, comfortable driving alignment across many stakeholders</li> <li>Experience building libraries, SDKs, developer tooling, or systems/run-time software</li> <li>Pragmatic product-engineering experience — you’ve worked with Product Managers and weighed technical trade-offs against customer impact</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>An application security background (WAF, RASP, IAST/SCA) or adjacent observability/APM experience</li> <li>Hands-on experience with one of our languages (.NET, Java, Go, Node.js, Python, Ruby, PHP) or open-source stewardship</li> <li>Experience leading distributed or multi-language teams across many stakeholders</li> </ul> <p><em>Datadog values people from all walks of life.
